analyst_view.overall: Iberia 1999 (29th of 36, 1 point) host Getafe (30th, 1 point) in Tbilisi, and both need a win to keep their hopes of the top 24 alive; Getafe have lost at home to Lugano (2-5) and Brighton (0-1) and drew at Craiova. Getafe's league form has also been poor, and José Bordalás has publicly questioned the squad's depth for three competitions; they rotate heavily (a team-news site says only 42% of the side is kept) and face Atlético Madrid next. Getafe are reported without Zaid Romero, Juanmi and Uche through injury; Gudelj's suspension is a LaLiga ban for his fifth yellow, so he can play here. Little news was available on Iberia, so the view relies on form and context. No referee is named; I make no change.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.7 of them for Getafe. Getafe must win, which pushes them forward, but they are also missing Juanmi and are likely to rotate before Atlético; the two roughly cancel out. I stay at 2.7.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.6 corners, more of them Getafe's, and already add a little for Getafe's high recent corner count. Bordalás' direct, wide style is in their record. I stay at 8.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards, already high for this competition and already up about 10% for Iberia's recent bookings. Getafe's physical style under Bordalás is in their record, and Gudelj's ban is only in LaLiga, so he may play. No referee is named; I stay at 5.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots and already add 7% to Getafe for their recent shot volume. I found no news to move it either way. I stay at 24.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.1 shots on target; Iberia have managed very few lately (4 in their last three), which the numbers already count. I stay at 8.1.
